subject: pclxs D12 grind (Opus, ABI 8): lvalue macros + checkout ledger
description:
Implement D12 (docs/decisions.md) per the grind item under plan.md 2b — read the ADR in full first; the semantics are oracle-pinned there.

One ABI bump (7→8, rule 6: conformance suite updated in the same change):
- ref_retarget(ref, new_target) vtable verb, optional group PCLXS_CAP_RETARGET; a DETECTED retarget on a host without it croaks naming SvRV_set.
- undefine_xsub(token) — required entry; host's `defined &name` must go false after sync and its AUTOLOAD fallback arms.
- PS_NO_SUB status from pclxs_invoke_xsub when the registration record's fnptr is NULL — host behaves exactly as calling a never-defined name.

Shim side: checkout ledger (slot, snapshot) reconciled at frame boundaries + pclxs_sv_export; the ->h audit rule from D12 (no RV's ->h reaches the host except through the reconciling path). CvXSUB(cv) = registration record fnptr slot; CvXSUBANY(cv) = existing XSANY slot; CvCONST_on/off/CvCONST flag ops; lvalue SvRV via per-RV referent cell + SvRV_set immediate spelling; PERL_MAGIC_UTF8_CACHESIZE (=2). refhost implements the three additions.

Conformance t/ per rule 5: ProxySubs demote-then-call dies through the host AUTOLOAD path ("Your vendor has not defined Socket macro X" shape — oracle-pinned), defined &missing false after boot, Clone-shaped retarget with RV identity pinned across the write + bless-in-same-frame.

Then re-survey the FULL corpus (also refreshes stale pre-D13 PL_op mentions in SURVEY.tsv rows). Expected movers: Socket, Socket-2.040-0, Fcntl, POSIX, File-Glob, Sys-Syslog, Clone, Storable.
